details: Mike McGlone, a senior commodity strategist at Bloomberg, warns that a clearer crypto buying opportunity might only emerge after the Bloomberg Galaxy Crypto Index falls as much as 50% from its recent peak. He cited oversupply, overhype, and overvaluation in the market, suggesting Bitcoin's 2025 surge above $100,000 could be a lasting peak.
title: Bloomberg Strategist Predicts Potential 50% Crypto Market Drop

details: Strategy Inc. (formerly MicroStrategy) acquired 3,273 Bitcoins for $255 million in the past seven days, funded by common stock sales. This indicates a slower accumulation rate compared to previous weeks but a continued commitment to Bitcoin holdings, bringing total reported holdings to 818,334 BTC.
title: Strategy Inc. Acquires $255M Bitcoin, Slowing Pace

details: Digital asset investment products attracted $1.2 billion in inflows last week, marking the fourth consecutive weekly gain. Bitcoin funds captured $933 million, and Ether funds attracted $192 million. Total crypto fund assets under management (AUM) rose to $155 billion, the highest level since February.
title: Crypto Funds Attract $1.2B Inflows, AUM Reaches $155B

details: Bitcoin developer James Lopp proposed freezing 5.6 million long-dormant Bitcoins (worth around $430 billion) to protect them from potential quantum computer attacks. This controversial plan aims to safeguard against future threats but raises concerns about breaking Bitcoin's core principle of inviolable property rights versus long-term security.
title: Bitcoin Devs Debate Freezing Dormant BTC for Quantum Security

details: The Ethereum Foundation offloaded 10,000 ETH to BitMine. This transfer follows a recent break in ETF inflow streak and is part of the foundation's asset management, potentially impacting short-term market sentiment.
title: Ethereum Foundation Transfers 10K ETH to BitMine
